title.zh-CN: 长程发热、跛行与重度贫血 · 3岁9月女孩
title.en: Prolonged fever, limp and severe anaemia · girl aged 3 years 9 months

summary.zh-CN: 3岁9个月的女孩发热七十多天，走路逐渐跛行，面色苍白；外院按全身型幼年特发性关节炎用激素后，发热又起。住院诊疗：从病史、查体到检查和治疗计划。
summary.en: A girl of 3 years 9 months has had fever for more than seventy days, a limp that came on gradually and pallor; after treatment elsewhere for systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis, the fever has returned. An inpatient case from history and examination to tests and a treatment plan.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说出本例中使全身型幼年特发性关节炎（JIA）诊断站不住脚的表现（起病时无皮疹、无浅表淋巴结肿大、血小板低至65×10⁹/L、乳酸脱氢酶1312 U/L、服激素期间再次发热），并在排除肿瘤和感染之前不加强免疫抑制，巨噬细胞活化综合征要检查证实而不是假定（EULAR/PReS 2024）。
learningOutcomes.en: Name the features that make the systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA) label unsafe here (no rash at onset, no enlarged lymph nodes, platelets as low as 65 × 10⁹/L, an LDH of 1312 U/L, fever returning on steroids) and hold further immunosuppression until malignancy and infection are excluded, testing for macrophage activation rather than assuming it (EULAR/PReS 2024).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解释为什么骨盆平片“未见明显破坏”和骨髓阴性都不能排除骨肿瘤，并依据MRI和增强CT所见判断需要取得组织（ESMO 2021）。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why pelvic radiographs without obvious destruction and a negative marrow do not exclude a bone tumour, and use the MRI and contrast-enhanced CT findings to decide that tissue is needed (ESMO 2021).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 与儿童骨肉瘤专科团队一起规划可疑骨肉瘤的活检：先查血小板和凝血，穿刺道能随日后手术切除，标本同时送病理、分子检测和培养；并说明擅自切开切除的危害。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan the biopsy of a suspected bone sarcoma with a paediatric bone sarcoma team — platelets and clotting checked first, a tract the later resection can remove, samples for histology, molecular testing and culture — and explain the harm of an unplanned excision.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 判断“尤文瘤、无融合基因结果”的活检报告和“病灶未逐个取材”的PET-CT能确定什么，并说出今天还需要的分子确认（WHO 2020、ESMO 2021）和分期检查。
learningOutcomes.en: Judge what a biopsy reported as Ewing tumour without a fusion result, and a PET-CT whose bone lesions were not each sampled, establish, and name the molecular confirmation (WHO 2020, ESMO 2021) and staging still needed today.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 概述今天的治疗路径——按方案化疗、由多学科团队决定局部治疗时机、治疗前讨论生育力保存——并与原报告的经过对比。
learningOutcomes.en: Outline today's treatment pathway — protocol chemotherapy, local control timed by the multidisciplinary team, fertility preservation discussed before treatment — and contrast it with the report's course.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用SPIKES向家长说明诊断和尚不确定的部分，并用回授法确认对方理解。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain the diagnosis and what is still uncertain to her parent using SPIKES, and check understanding with teach-back.

triageNote.zh-CN: 3岁9个月女孩，体重15.9 kg，家长陪同入院。发热70余天，逐渐出现跛行。曾被诊断为全身型幼年特发性关节炎，用激素后热退，继续口服期间又发热。贫血明显。
triageNote.en: Girl aged 3 years 9 months, 15.9 kg, admitted with her parent. Fever for more than 70 days and a limp that came on gradually. Previously diagnosed with systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis; the fever settled on steroids and returned while she was still taking them by mouth. Marked anaemia.

personality.en: A girl of 3 years 9 months who has had fever for more than seventy days; she is pale, lying in bed and does not want to walk. Her parent is at the bedside.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 孩子太小，病史由家长用日常口语回答；不用医学术语，不知道的就直说不知道。
speechStyle.en: She is too young to give her own history; her parent answers in everyday words, without medical terms, and says plainly when they do not know.

openingLine.zh-CN: （清和躺在床上，脸色苍白；家长替她说）她发烧七十多天了，现在走路也跛了。
openingLine.en: (Qinghe is lying in bed, pale; her parent speaks for her) She's had a fever for more than seventy days, and now she's limping.

fallbackUnknown.en: I'm not sure about that, doctor.

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：孩子3岁9个月，不回答病史问题。家长回答所有病史问题，只讲自己知道的：发热七十多天，起初38℃左右，后来最高39.5℃、一天好几次；慢慢出现轻度跛行、不愿走路，起初关节没有明显肿痛；外院按幼年特发性关节炎用激素后热退，继续口服期间又发热；来这儿之前诊断的是全身型幼年特发性关节炎；最近差不多一个月断断续续抗感染，烧还是加重；起病时没有皮疹、出血点、口腔溃疡或脱发；以前身体健康，没接触过结核、肝炎病人，疫苗按计划打；体重15.9公斤。激素的名字、剂量、疗程和现在还吃不吃，用的是哪些抗生素，过敏、疼痛、体重变化、出血、大小便、家族史和接触史都说不上来，不要编。检查结果和诊断让医生说；后面阶段的结果不要提前说。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: the child is 3 years 9 months old and does not answer history questions. Her parent answers every history question and says only what they know: fever for more than seventy days, about 38 °C at first and later up to 39.5 °C several times a day; a slight limp that came on gradually and reluctance to walk, with no obvious joint swelling or pain at first; steroids at another hospital for juvenile idiopathic arthritis settled the fever, which came back while she was still taking them by mouth; before coming here she was diagnosed with systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis; on-and-off treatment for infection for about the last month while the fever still got worse; no rash, bleeding spots, mouth ulcers or hair loss at the start; previously healthy, no contact with TB or hepatitis, vaccinations on schedule; weight 15.9 kg. The steroid's name, dose, duration and whether she still takes it, which antibiotics were used, allergies, pain, weight change, bleeding, bladder and bowels, family history and exposures are not known — never invent them. Results and the diagnosis are for the doctors; never mention a later phase's results early.

persona.zh-CN: 陪孩子住院的家长，回答所有病史问题。只讲自己知道或听医生说过的事，不知道就直说，不替医生下结论。
persona.en: The parent staying with her, who answers every history question. Says only what they know or have heard from doctors, says so plainly when they do not know, and draws no medical conclusions.

label.en: Admission: fever back and a limp

description.zh-CN: 3岁9个月的女孩发热七十多天，走路逐渐跛行。外院按全身型幼年特发性关节炎给她用了激素，热退后在继续口服期间又发热。向家长了解病史，给她查体，决定下一步。
description.en: A girl of 3 years 9 months has had fever for more than seventy days and a limp that came on gradually. Another hospital treated her for systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis with steroids; the fever settled and came back while she was still taking them by mouth. Take the history from her parent, examine her and decide the next step.

description.en: The right iliac biopsy has been reported and a PET-CT is available (their order is not recorded). Judge what the results establish and agree the treatment with her parent.

name.zh-CN: 由骨肉瘤团队规划的影像引导下髂骨病灶穿刺活检
name.en: Image-guided core biopsy of the iliac lesion, planned with the bone sarcoma team

dose.zh-CN: 按骨肉瘤团队规划的穿刺道，在影像引导下粗针多点取材；标本送病理、分子检测（新鲜或冰冻组织）和培养；术前确认当天血小板和凝血结果，并告知麻醉医生她的激素用药史。
dose.en: Image-guided core needle biopsy with several cores, along the tract the bone sarcoma team has planned; samples for histology, molecular testing (fresh or frozen tissue) and culture; today's platelet count and clotting checked first, and the anaesthetist told about her steroid treatment.

harm.zh-CN: 先转诊：ESMO 2021要求可疑骨肉瘤的活检由将来做根治手术的外科团队来做，或由介入放射科医生与该外科医生商定后进行。她的血小板最低到过65×10⁹/L：针进骨头之前先查血常规和凝血（国家卫健委2019年规范把凝血功能列为治疗前应了解的检查），并让麻醉医生了解她的激素用药。
harm.en: Refer her first: ESMO 2021 has the biopsy of a suspected bone sarcoma done by the surgical team who will resect it, or by an interventional radiologist after discussing it with that surgeon. And her platelet count has been as low as 65 × 10⁹/L: check her count and clotting before a needle goes into bone (China's 2019 national guideline lists clotting among the tests to know before treatment), and let the anaesthetist know about her steroid treatment.

response.zh-CN: 已在影像引导下完成粗针活检，组织已送病理、分子检测和培养。原报告记录做了右髂骨活检，但没有写明活检方式和由谁规划。
response.en: Image-guided core biopsy done; tissue sent for histology, molecular testing and culture. The report records a right iliac biopsy but not how it was taken or who planned it.

dose.zh-CN: 当天血红蛋白低于阈值时输注红细胞（BSH 2016：病情稳定的儿童为70 g/L，儿童肿瘤患者70–80 g/L较为合理）；按体重计算输注量，使输后血红蛋白不超过阈值20 g/L；输血前先留血涂片和配血标本。
dose.en: Red cells if today's haemoglobin is below the threshold (BSH 2016: 70 g/L in a stable child; 70–80 g/L is reasonable in children with cancer); volume calculated from her weight so that the post-transfusion haemoglobin is no more than 20 g/L above the threshold; send the blood film and the group-and-screen sample first.

harm.zh-CN: 输血要对照测得的血红蛋白：BSH 2016对病情稳定的儿童以70 g/L为阈值（儿童肿瘤患者70–80 g/L较为合理），输注量以输后不超过阈值20 g/L为度。先看她的血常规。
harm.en: A transfusion is given against a measured haemoglobin: BSH 2016 uses a threshold of 70 g/L in a stable child (70–80 g/L is reasonable in children with cancer) and a volume that brings it no more than 20 g/L above the threshold. Read her blood count first.

response.zh-CN: 已送配血并申请红细胞：只有当天血红蛋白低于阈值时才输，输注量按体重（15.9 kg）计算。她的病历没有记录当天的血红蛋白，也没有记录病程中是否输过血。
response.en: Group and screen sent and red cells requested: they are to be given only if today's haemoglobin is below the threshold, in a volume worked out from her weight (15.9 kg). Today's haemoglobin is not recorded in her notes, nor whether she was transfused in her recorded course.

dose.en: A conversation with her parent in a quiet room (SPIKES): find out what they know and want to know, explain the diagnosis, what is still uncertain and the next steps in plain words, respond to emotion and check understanding with teach-back.

response.en: The fertility-preservation team has been asked to see her parent before chemotherapy. Her notes do not mention fertility.

dose.en: Transfer to the paediatric haematology–oncology team for chemotherapy on a current Ewing sarcoma protocol.

harm.zh-CN: 化疗要等组织诊断：ESMO 2021以活检作为可疑骨肿瘤的确诊依据，而不同肿瘤的治疗各不相同；取材前开始化疗可能让诊断再也无法明确。
harm.en: Chemotherapy waits for a tissue diagnosis: ESMO 2021 makes the biopsy the definitive diagnosis of a suspected bone tumour, and treatment differs between tumour types; chemotherapy before tissue is taken can make the diagnosis impossible.

response.zh-CN: 已安排转儿童血液肿瘤团队。
response.en: Transfer to the paediatric haematology–oncology team arranged.

name.zh-CN: 静脉甲泼尼龙冲击治疗“难治性全身型JIA”
name.en: IV methylprednisolone pulse for “refractory systemic JIA”

dose.zh-CN: 按全身型JIA方案静脉甲泼尼龙冲击。
dose.en: Methylprednisolone by IV pulse, as for refractory systemic JIA.

harm.zh-CN: 病因未明就加大激素，是在按诊断标签治疗。EULAR/PReS 2024要求在治疗Still病（全身型JIA）之前认真考虑肿瘤、感染等其他诊断，并提醒一旦误诊，糖皮质激素可能有害，尤其是肿瘤时。大剂量激素会压住发热、部分治疗白血病或淋巴瘤，让诊断推迟并变得模糊。
harm.en: Raising the steroids before the cause is known treats a label. EULAR/PReS 2024 asks that malignancy, infection and other mimics be carefully considered before Still's disease (systemic JIA) is treated, and warns that glucocorticoids can be deleterious when it is misdiagnosed, particularly in malignancy. Pulsed steroids can blunt the fever and partly treat a leukaemia or lymphoma, delaying and blurring the diagnosis.

response.zh-CN: 已给药。这不在她记录的病程中。冲击治疗针对的是“关节炎”标签：取得组织之前，它会压住发热、让活检所见变得模糊；对骨肿瘤也没有治疗作用。
response.en: Given. It is not part of her recorded course. A pulse treats the arthritis label: before tissue is taken it can blunt the fever and blur what a biopsy would show, and it treats no bone tumour.

name.zh-CN: 开始IL-1或IL-6抑制剂治疗“难治性全身型JIA”
name.en: Start an IL-1 or IL-6 inhibitor for “refractory systemic JIA”

dose.zh-CN: 按全身型JIA用托珠单抗或阿那白滞素。
dose.en: Tocilizumab or anakinra, as for systemic JIA.

harm.zh-CN: EULAR/PReS 2024建议在Still病诊断确立后尽早使用IL-1或IL-6抑制剂（推荐7）；她的诊断并未确立，肿瘤和感染也还没有排除。IL-6阻断还会压低发热和C反应蛋白，而这正是你需要追踪的指标。
harm.en: EULAR/PReS 2024 starts an IL-1 or IL-6 inhibitor once the diagnosis of Still's disease is established (recommendation 7); hers is not, and malignancy and infection have not been excluded. IL-6 blockade also suppresses fever and CRP, the very signs you need to follow.

response.zh-CN: 已开始。这不在她记录的病程中；她的发热和C反应蛋白从此更难解读，而它针对的是证据并不支持的诊断标签。
response.en: Started. It is not part of her recorded course; her fever and CRP are now harder to interpret, and it treats a label the evidence does not support.

name.zh-CN: 由本院骨科立即切开切除或刮除髂骨包块
name.en: Open excision or curettage of the iliac mass by the local orthopaedic team now

dose.zh-CN: 在本院骨科手术室切开，切除或刮除髂骨包块，同时取病理。
dose.en: Open operation by the local orthopaedic team to excise or curette the iliac mass and send it for histology.

harm.zh-CN: ESMO–EURACAN–GENTURIS–ERN PaedCan 2021：可疑骨肉瘤的活检应由将来做根治手术的团队来做（或由介入放射科医生与该外科医生商定后进行），尤文肉瘤应避免病灶内手术。未经规划的切除或刮除会把肿瘤带到周围组织，可能使日后无法做到切缘阴性的切除。
harm.en: ESMO–EURACAN–GENTURIS–ERN PaedCan 2021: the biopsy of a suspected bone sarcoma is done by the team who will do the definitive resection (or by an interventional radiologist after discussing it with that surgeon), and intralesional surgery is to be avoided in Ewing sarcoma. An unplanned excision or curettage spreads tumour into the surrounding tissue and can rule out a later resection with clear margins.

response.zh-CN: 手术已做，拿到了组织，但瘤床被打开，周围组织受到污染；之后的手术或放疗都要覆盖更大的范围。原报告记录的是活检，不是切除。
response.en: Done. Tissue is obtained, but the tumour bed has been opened and the surrounding tissue contaminated; any later surgery or radiotherapy must now cover a wider field. The report records a biopsy, not an excision.

name.zh-CN: 再给一疗程经验性静脉抗生素（按骨髓炎）
name.en: Another empirical IV antibiotic course for presumed osteomyelitis

dose.zh-CN: 按骨髓炎经验性静脉抗生素治疗。
dose.en: Empirical IV antibiotics, as for osteomyelitis.

harm.zh-CN: 她已经断断续续抗感染差不多一个月，烧还在加重。ESPID 2017要求用抗生素前一定先做血培养，并指出亚急性骨髓炎可与恶性肿瘤混淆，通常需要活检才能确诊；再盲目用一疗程，会降低培养和组织检查的阳性率，延误诊断。
harm.en: She has already had about a month of intermittent anti-infective treatment while the fever got worse. ESPID 2017 asks for a blood culture before any antibiotic and notes that subacute osteomyelitis can be confused with malignancy and usually needs a biopsy for the diagnosis; another blind course lowers the yield of cultures and tissue and delays the diagnosis.

response.zh-CN: 已开始。她的病历没有记录再一个疗程的抗生素；此后留取的培养更难长出细菌。
response.en: Started. A further course is not recorded in her notes; cultures taken from now on are less likely to grow an organism.

title.en: Take the history from her parent

hint.zh-CN: 问清发热和跛行怎么开始、怎么变化，用过哪些治疗、效果怎样，发热时还有什么别的表现。
hint.en: Ask how the fever and the limp began and changed, what treatment she has had and how she responded, and what else came with the fever.

guidance.zh-CN: 清和太小，病史由家长回答。
guidance.en: Qinghe is too young to give the history; her parent answers.

hint.zh-CN: 看面色，摸浅表淋巴结，看皮肤，再检查关节、髋部和下肢。
hint.en: Look at her colour, feel for lymph nodes, look at her skin, then examine her joints, hips and legs.

guidance.zh-CN: 她躺在床上，不愿意下地走路。
guidance.en: She is lying in bed and does not want to walk.

hint.zh-CN: 先把病史和查体所见想清楚，再决定下一步。
hint.en: Weigh what her history and examination show before you choose the next step.

guidance.zh-CN: 外院的诊断和激素治疗都在病史里。
guidance.en: The other hospital's diagnosis and the steroid course are in her history.

hint.zh-CN: 逐一调阅血液检查、骨髓和每一项影像，想一想每一项能排除什么、不能排除什么。
hint.en: Read the blood results, the marrow and each imaging study, and ask what each one can and cannot exclude.

guidance.zh-CN: 她的检查结果都在病历里。
guidance.en: Her results are in the records.

title.en: Plan the route to a diagnosis

hint.zh-CN: 想一想该由谁来做、在哪里做、怎样做，做之前要先查什么。
hint.en: Think about who should do it, where and how, and what must be checked first.

guidance.zh-CN: 下一步的每个选择都会影响她以后的治疗。
guidance.en: Each choice at this step shapes her later treatment.

title.en: Interpret the findings and agree a plan

hint.zh-CN: 分清报告证明了什么、只是提示了什么，再和家长商定治疗计划，最后看原报告的后续经过。
hint.en: Separate what the reports prove from what they only suggest, agree a plan with her parent, then read the reported course.

prompt.zh-CN: 清和3岁9个月，发热七十多天、走路跛、面色苍白。外院按全身型幼年特发性关节炎用激素，热退后在继续口服期间又发热。你下一步怎么做？
prompt.en: Qinghe, 3 years 9 months, has had fever for more than seventy days and a limp, and she is pale. Another hospital treated her for systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis with steroids; the fever settled and came back while she was still taking them. What is your next step?

need.zh-CN: 先问清发热、跛行和激素治疗的经过，并给她查体。
need.en: Take the history of the fever, the limp and the steroid treatment, and examine her first.

text.zh-CN: 把全身型JIA当作未经证实的诊断：暂不加量激素、不加新的免疫抑制药，先查肿瘤、感染和巨噬细胞活化综合征——血常规和涂片、血培养、铁蛋白、骨髓，以及髋部和骨盆影像。
text.en: Treat the systemic JIA label as unproven: no higher steroid dose and no new immunosuppressant for now, and look first for malignancy, infection and macrophage activation — blood count and film, cultures, ferritin, marrow, and imaging of the hips and pelvis.

feedback.zh-CN: 对。全身型JIA是排除性诊断，而她并不符合：起病时发热只有38℃左右、没有皮疹，查体没有淋巴结肿大（ILAR标准要求在关节炎和发热之外，至少有皮疹、全身淋巴结肿大、肝脾肿大或浆膜炎之一；后两项她的病历没有记录），她还面色苍白、走路跛。NICE NG12（2015，2026年更新）要求对面色苍白或不明原因发热的儿童尽快查血常规；EULAR/PReS 2024要求认真考虑肿瘤、感染等其他诊断，因为误诊时激素和免疫调节药可能有害。贫血、用着激素仍发热，也要想到巨噬细胞活化综合征，要用铁蛋白、纤维蛋白原、甘油三酯和肝功能来查，而不是猜。激素也不要突然停：先问清剂量和疗程，再计划减量。
feedback.en: Right. Systemic JIA is a diagnosis of exclusion, and hers does not fit: the fever was about 38 °C at the start with no rash, and she has no enlarged lymph nodes (ILAR needs, besides arthritis and fever, at least one of rash, generalised lymphadenopathy, liver or spleen enlargement or serositis — the last two are not recorded for her), and she is pale with a limp. NICE NG12 (2015, updated 2026) asks for a very urgent blood count in a child with pallor or unexplained fever, and EULAR/PReS 2024 asks that malignancy, infection and other mimics be carefully considered because steroids and immunomodulators can do harm when the diagnosis is wrong. Anaemia with a fever that persists on steroids also raises macrophage activation, which is tested with ferritin, fibrinogen, triglycerides and liver tests, not assumed. Do not stop her steroids abruptly either: find out the dose and duration and plan any reduction.

text.zh-CN: 按激素依赖的全身型JIA处理：先静脉甲泼尼龙冲击三天把热控制住，再加用甲氨蝶呤作为减激素的药物，之后几周内逐渐减停口服激素，出院后在风湿门诊随访，定期复查血常规和肝功能。
text.en: Treat this as steroid-dependent systemic JIA: give three days of IV methylprednisolone pulses to bring the fever under control, then add methotrexate as a steroid-sparing drug, taper the oral steroids over the following weeks and follow her up in the rheumatology clinic with blood counts and liver tests.

feedback.zh-CN: 加大激素是在治疗一个标签，而不是诊断。EULAR/PReS 2024提醒，Still病（全身型JIA）一旦误诊，糖皮质激素或免疫调节药可能有害，尤其是病因为肿瘤时。激素能压住发热、部分治疗白血病或淋巴瘤，使诊断更难。她在口服激素期间再次发热，这是怀疑诊断的理由，而不是加量的理由。
feedback.en: Escalating steroids treats a label, not a diagnosis. EULAR/PReS 2024 warns that glucocorticoids or immunomodulators can be deleterious when Still's disease (systemic JIA) is misdiagnosed, particularly when a malignancy is the cause. Steroids can mask the fever and partly treat a leukaemia or lymphoma, making the diagnosis harder. Her fever came back during oral steroids — a reason to doubt the label, not to raise the dose.

text.zh-CN: 按难治性全身型JIA处理：现在就开始IL-1或IL-6抑制剂，因为现行风湿病指南更推荐它而不是长期激素；热退后逐渐减停口服激素，两周后在风湿门诊复查发热、关节和炎症指标。
text.en: Treat this as refractory systemic JIA: start an IL-1 or IL-6 inhibitor now, which current rheumatology guidance prefers to long-term steroids, wean the oral steroid once the fever has settled, and review her fever, joints and inflammatory markers in the rheumatology clinic in two weeks.

feedback.zh-CN: IL-1或IL-6阻断是全身型JIA确诊后的首选治疗（ACR 2021；EULAR/PReS 2024推荐7：“诊断确立后”）。她的诊断并未确立：分类所需的表现不全，面色苍白和跛行也指向别处。IL-6阻断还会压低发热和C反应蛋白，而追踪感染或肿瘤恰恰要靠这些指标。
feedback.en: IL-1 or IL-6 blockade is the preferred treatment once systemic JIA is established (ACR 2021; EULAR/PReS 2024 recommendation 7: “when the diagnosis is established”). Hers is not: the classification features are missing, and her pallor and limp point elsewhere. IL-6 blockade also suppresses fever and CRP, the very signs you would use to follow an infection or a tumour.

text.zh-CN: 她用着激素仍发热、面色苍白，按全身型JIA并发巨噬细胞活化综合征处理：不等其他检查，马上用环孢素加大剂量静脉激素，因为它可以在数小时内加重。
text.en: Treat this as macrophage activation syndrome complicating systemic JIA, as the fever persists on steroids and she is pale: start ciclosporin with high-dose IV steroids straight away, before further tests, because it can worsen within hours.

feedback.zh-CN: 巨噬细胞活化综合征值得排查——EULAR/PReS 2024把“不相称的血细胞减少”列为警示表现之一——但要用铁蛋白、纤维蛋白原、甘油三酯、肝功能和骨髓来证实，而不是假定。在这些检查之前、在排除肿瘤之前就用环孢素和大剂量激素，可能掩盖真正的病因。
feedback.en: Macrophage activation is worth checking — EULAR/PReS 2024 lists inappropriately low cell counts among its warning signs — but it is confirmed with ferritin, fibrinogen, triglycerides, liver tests and the marrow, not assumed. Ciclosporin and high-dose steroids before those tests, and before malignancy is excluded, can mask the real cause.

prompt.zh-CN: 平片未见明显骨质破坏，但MRI示右髂骨及周围包块、弥散受限，增强CT示包绕髂骨的肿块、骨膜反应和骶骨异常；骨髓红系增生，未报告确诊的肿瘤浸润。你怎么综合解读？
prompt.en: The radiographs show no obvious bone destruction, but MRI shows a mass in and around the right ilium with restricted diffusion, and contrast-enhanced CT a mass encasing the ilium with periosteal reaction and a sacral abnormality; the marrow shows erythroid hyperplasia without confirmed tumour. How do you read these together?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅血常规、骨髓和每一项影像记录。
need.en: Read the blood count, the marrow and each imaging record first.

text.zh-CN: 髂骨包块伴骨膜反应，在证实之前按骨肿瘤对待——她这个年龄要考虑转移性神经母细胞瘤、尤文肉瘤、淋巴瘤或朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞增生症；平片和骨髓都排除不了，骨髓炎也仍有可能，需要组织。
text.en: An iliac mass with periosteal reaction is a bone tumour until shown otherwise — at her age metastatic neuroblastoma, Ewing sarcoma, lymphoma or Langerhans cell histiocytosis; neither the films nor the marrow excludes them, osteomyelitis remains possible, and tissue is needed.

feedback.zh-CN: 对。ESMO–EURACAN–GENTURIS–ERN PaedCan 2021以平片为第一步，但只要平片不能排除恶性病变，就要做包括整个间室的MRI；它还指出5岁以下儿童的破坏性骨病灶最常见的是转移性神经母细胞瘤或朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞增生症。骨盆平片常常看不出肿瘤，骨髓阴性排除不了实体瘤，亚急性骨髓炎的表现也可以与肿瘤相同——ESPID 2017指出它可与恶性肿瘤混淆、通常需要活检确诊。下一步是取得组织。
feedback.en: Right. ESMO–EURACAN–GENTURIS–ERN PaedCan 2021 makes radiographs the first test but asks for MRI of the whole compartment whenever they cannot exclude malignancy, and notes that under 5 years of age a destructive bone lesion is most often metastatic neuroblastoma or Langerhans cell histiocytosis. Pelvic films often miss a tumour, a negative marrow does not exclude a solid tumour, and subacute osteomyelitis can look the same — ESPID 2017 notes it can be confused with malignancy and usually needs a biopsy. The next step is tissue.

text.zh-CN: 平片是诊断骨肿瘤的标准检查，平片没有骨质破坏，MRI和CT的改变就是全身型JIA的反应性骨髓水肿和滑膜炎，不需要活检，原诊断可以维持，继续目前的激素治疗，三个月后再复查一次骨盆平片看有无变化即可。
text.en: Plain films are the reference test for bone tumours; with no destruction on them, the MRI and CT changes are the reactive marrow oedema and synovitis of systemic JIA, so no biopsy is needed, the label stands and her current treatment continues, with a repeat pelvic film in three months.

feedback.zh-CN: 平片是第一步，不是最后一步：ESMO 2021要求平片不能排除恶性时做MRI，而骨盆的肿瘤在平片上常常看起来正常。带骨膜反应的包块不是关节炎的滑膜炎。
feedback.en: Radiographs are the first test, not the last: ESMO 2021 asks for MRI whenever they cannot exclude malignancy, and pelvic tumours often look normal on plain films. A mass with periosteal reaction is not the synovitis of arthritis.

text.zh-CN: MRI上弥散受限说明是脓液，骨膜反应也符合骨感染：这是抗感染不彻底之后形成的骨盆骨髓炎合并脓肿，应在影像引导下穿刺引流脓液、送培养，再足量用满六周的静脉抗生素，骨头本身不必再做活检。
text.en: Restricted diffusion on MRI means pus, and periosteal reaction is how bone infection looks: this is pelvic osteomyelitis with an abscess after a partly treated infection, so arrange image-guided drainage of the collection and six weeks of intravenous antibiotics, without a biopsy of the bone itself.

feedback.zh-CN: 脓肿确实会弥散受限，但细胞密集的肿瘤也会；而且她已经用了约一个月抗感染治疗，烧仍在加重。不取骨组织就引流、用药，可能漏掉肿瘤。ESPID 2017指出亚急性骨髓炎可与恶性肿瘤混淆、通常需要活检；取到的组织应同时送病理和培养。
feedback.en: An abscess does restrict diffusion, but so does a densely cellular tumour, and about a month of anti-infective treatment has already failed her. Draining and treating without bone tissue risks missing a tumour: ESPID 2017 notes that subacute osteomyelitis can be confused with malignancy and usually needs a biopsy — and the tissue should go for both histology and culture.

text.zh-CN: 骨髓只有红系增生、没有肿瘤，白血病和骨髓转移都不太可能，她的贫血其实是慢性炎症所致；肿瘤因此已经可以排除，继续目前的治疗，每周复查一次血常规和炎症指标，六周后再复查一次MRI即可。
text.en: The marrow shows only erythroid hyperplasia and no tumour, which makes leukaemia and marrow spread unlikely and explains her anaemia as inflammation; malignancy is therefore excluded, so continue her current treatment, follow her blood counts every week and repeat the MRI in six weeks.

feedback.zh-CN: 红系增生只是一种反应，不是诊断；骨髓取材可能漏掉局灶病变，也说明不了骨盆的包块是什么。不对病灶本身取材，就谈不上排除肿瘤。
feedback.en: Erythroid hyperplasia is a reaction, not a diagnosis; a marrow sample can miss focal disease and says nothing about what the pelvic mass is. Malignancy is not excluded until the lesion itself is sampled.

prompt.zh-CN: 需要从髂骨病灶取得组织。她的血小板最低到过65×10⁹/L。应该怎样取？
prompt.en: Tissue is needed from the iliac lesion, and her platelet count has been as low as 65 × 10⁹/L. How should the tissue be obtained?

need.zh-CN: 先解读她的影像和骨髓结果。
need.en: Interpret her imaging and marrow results first.

text.zh-CN: 任何人取组织之前，先转诊儿童肿瘤及骨肉瘤团队，由他们规划影像引导下粗针活检，穿刺道能随日后手术切除；先查血小板和凝血，标本送病理、分子检测和培养。
text.en: Refer her to the paediatric oncology and bone sarcoma team before anyone takes tissue: they plan an image-guided core biopsy along a tract the resection can later remove, after checking platelets and clotting, with samples for histology, molecular tests and culture.

feedback.zh-CN: 对。ESMO 2021：影像怀疑原发骨肉瘤的儿童应转诊到具备儿童专长的骨肉瘤中心；活检由将来做根治手术的外科团队来做，或由介入放射科医生与该外科医生商定后进行；多数情况下影像引导下粗针活检是合适的；穿刺道要标记，日后随肿瘤一并切除；标本要能做分子检测。先确认当天的血小板和凝血，并让麻醉医生了解她的激素用药。
feedback.en: Right. ESMO 2021: a child whose imaging suggests a primary bone sarcoma is referred to a sarcoma centre with paediatric expertise; the biopsy is done by the surgical team who will do the resection, or by an interventional radiologist after discussing it with that surgeon; an image-guided core biopsy is usually appropriate; the tract is marked and later removed with the tumour; and the samples must allow molecular testing. Check today's platelets and clotting first, and tell the anaesthetist about her steroid treatment.

text.zh-CN: 请本院骨科现在就切开，把髂骨包块整块切除或刮除干净，一次麻醉、一次手术同时拿到诊断和治疗，免得转诊到别的中心耽误时间，孩子还要再多受一次麻醉和操作。
text.en: Ask the local orthopaedic team to excise or curette the iliac mass now through an open approach, so that a single operation under one anaesthetic gives both the diagnosis and the treatment, and she avoids the delay of a referral to another centre and a second procedure.

feedback.zh-CN: 未经规划的切除或刮除会污染组织间隙，可能让日后保留肢体或骨盆的切除无法做到，而且没有任何好处：ESMO 2021要求活检由将来做根治手术的团队规划，并指出尤文肉瘤应避免病灶内手术。
feedback.en: An unplanned excision or curettage contaminates the tissue planes, can make a later limb- or pelvis-sparing resection impossible and brings no benefit: ESMO 2021 asks for the biopsy to be planned by the team who will do the definitive surgery and says intralesional surgery is to be avoided in Ewing sarcoma.

text.zh-CN: 再做一次骨髓检查，这次从双侧髂嵴各做穿刺和活检；如果仍没有肿瘤，髂骨病灶就不必单独活检，六周后复查MRI观察即可。
text.en: Repeat the marrow examination, this time with aspirates and trephines from both iliac crests; if they again show no tumour, the iliac lesion needs no biopsy of its own and can be watched with a repeat MRI in six weeks.

feedback.zh-CN: 再多的骨髓阴性结果也排除不了实体骨肿瘤，也说明不了包块是什么；骨盆包块再等六周只会耽误时间。必须对病灶本身取材。
feedback.en: Further negative marrow samples would not exclude a solid bone tumour either, nor say what the mass is; waiting six weeks with a pelvic mass loses time. The lesion itself has to be sampled.

text.zh-CN: 排进下一次放射科检查，用镇静代替全麻，从最近的路径做细针穿刺，不必和外科商量；单凭细胞学结果就足以开始治疗。
text.en: Book a fine-needle aspirate of the mass at the next radiology list, by the shortest route and under sedation rather than a general anaesthetic, without involving the surgeons; cytology alone will be enough to start treatment.

feedback.zh-CN: 细针抽吸很少能提供足够做病理、免疫组化和分子检测的组织；不与外科商量就选的穿刺路径，可能污染日后切除无法包括的组织间隙（ESMO 2021：活检要与将做切除的外科医生商定）。
feedback.en: A fine-needle aspirate rarely gives enough tissue for histology, immunohistochemistry and molecular tests, and a route chosen without the surgeon may contaminate compartments the later resection cannot include (ESMO 2021: plan the biopsy with the surgeon who will do the resection).

prompt.zh-CN: 右髂骨活检报告为尤文瘤，没有分子检测结果；PET-CT示多部位骨病灶，报告考虑转移或多中心，病灶未逐个取材。这些结果能确定什么？
prompt.en: The right iliac biopsy is reported as Ewing tumour, without a molecular result; PET-CT shows multiple bone lesions, reported as metastatic or multicentric, which were not each sampled. What do these results establish?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅活检病理报告和PET-CT。
need.en: Read the biopsy report and the PET-CT first.

text.zh-CN: 它们使尤文肉瘤伴多发骨病灶成为很可能的诊断；但还需要在活检组织上证实EWSR1（FET）–ETS融合，以排除形态相似的圆细胞肉瘤，分期还需胸部CT，并对会改变方案的可疑病灶活检。
text.en: They make Ewing sarcoma with multiple bone lesions likely, but the diagnosis still needs an EWSR1 (FET)–ETS fusion on the biopsy to exclude look-alike round-cell sarcomas, and staging needs a chest CT and a biopsy of any lesion whose nature would change the plan.

feedback.zh-CN: 对。ESMO 2021：尤文肉瘤以FET–ETS融合（通常为EWSR1–FLI1）为特征，必须做分子确认，才能与其他圆细胞肉瘤区分；WHO 2020分类已把CIC重排肉瘤和BCOR改变肉瘤单列，它们的生物学行为不同。分期要查肺、骨和骨髓转移：胸部CT和PET-CT（或全身MRI），可疑病灶要活检。2012年发表的这份报告没有融合基因结果；今天会在组织条件允许时用已有的活检组织补做检测，而不是一切重来。
feedback.en: Right. ESMO 2021: Ewing sarcoma is marked by a FET–ETS fusion (usually EWSR1–FLI1), and molecular confirmation is mandatory to separate it from other round-cell sarcomas; the WHO 2020 classification now places CIC-rearranged and BCOR-altered sarcomas apart, with different behaviour. Staging looks for lung, bone and marrow metastases with chest CT and PET-CT (or whole-body MRI), and doubtful lesions are biopsied. The report, published in 2012, gives no fusion result; today the test would be added on the existing biopsy tissue, where the tissue allows, rather than starting again.

text.zh-CN: PET-CT已经证明每一处高摄取的骨都是转移，诊断时就已无法治愈；不需要再做任何检查，也不必做化疗，只向家属提供姑息治疗和止痛药物，以后哪一处骨头疼了，再对那一处骨头做姑息性放疗。
text.en: PET-CT has proven a metastasis in every avid bone, so the disease is incurable at diagnosis; no further tests are needed, and the family should be offered palliative care alone, with no chemotherapy and with radiotherapy only for any bone that later becomes painful.

feedback.zh-CN: 高摄取不等于病理证实：炎症或修复中的骨也可以摄取，ESMO 2021要求对可疑病灶活检。即使证实为多发骨转移，治疗目标仍是治愈；ESMO 2021指出多发骨转移的预后明显差于单纯肺转移，但这不是诊断时只给姑息治疗的理由。
feedback.en: Avidity is not histology: inflamed or healing bone can take up tracer, and ESMO 2021 asks for doubtful lesions to be biopsied. Even confirmed multiple bone metastases are treated with curative intent; ESMO 2021 notes they carry a much poorer outcome than lung metastases alone, but that is no reason to offer palliation only at diagnosis.

text.zh-CN: 单凭病理报告就能确诊，分子检测只对科研有意义；多处骨的PET高摄取已经确定为转移，分期已经完成，不必再做胸部CT、融合基因检测或对其他病灶活检，可以马上按转移性尤文肉瘤的方案开始化疗。
text.en: The histology report alone is diagnostic and molecular tests only matter for research; PET-CT avidity in several bones already settles the stage as metastatic, so chemotherapy can start at once without a chest CT, fusion testing or any biopsy of the other lesions.

feedback.zh-CN: ESMO 2021规定必须做分子确认：没有FET–ETS融合的圆细胞肉瘤可能是CIC重排或BCOR改变肉瘤（WHO 2020），它们的行为和对治疗的反应不同。单靠PET-CT也不能完成分期：肺部还需要胸部CT。
feedback.en: ESMO 2021 makes molecular confirmation mandatory: a round-cell sarcoma without a FET–ETS fusion may be a CIC-rearranged or BCOR-altered sarcoma (WHO 2020), which behave and respond differently. Nor does PET-CT alone complete staging: the lungs need a chest CT.

text.zh-CN: 多处骨病灶但只有一处证实是肿瘤，说明其余病灶是多灶性骨髓炎，这也能解释她长期发热：髂骨按尤文肉瘤治疗，其余部位用长疗程静脉抗生素。
text.en: Several avid bones with a tumour proven in only one suggest the other lesions are multifocal osteomyelitis, which would also fit her long fever: treat the ilium as Ewing sarcoma and give the other sites a long course of intravenous antibiotics.

feedback.zh-CN: 尤文肉瘤患儿出现多处高摄取骨病灶，在证实之前应视为转移；不取组织就当作感染，会让她的治疗不足。若某个病灶的性质会改变方案，ESMO 2021要求对它活检。
feedback.en: Multiple avid bones in a child with Ewing sarcoma are metastases until shown otherwise; calling them infection without tissue would under-treat her. If a lesion's nature would change the plan, ESMO 2021 asks for it to be biopsied.

prompt.zh-CN: 家长问接下来怎么治。你建议什么方案？
prompt.en: Her parent asks what happens next. Which plan do you recommend?

need.zh-CN: 先判断活检和PET-CT能确定什么。
need.en: Decide first what the biopsy and the PET-CT establish.

text.zh-CN: 在儿童肿瘤团队按现行尤文肉瘤方案治疗：先多药联合化疗，再由骨肉瘤团队决定骨盆的局部治疗（手术、放疗或两者），治疗前讨论生育力保存。
text.en: Care under a paediatric oncology team on a current Ewing sarcoma protocol: multi-agent chemotherapy first, then local control of the pelvis by surgery, radiotherapy or both as the sarcoma team decides, with fertility preservation discussed before treatment.

feedback.zh-CN: 对。ESMO 2021：骨肉瘤应在专科中心治疗；尤文肉瘤先做诱导化疗（长春新碱、多柔比星、环磷酰胺或异环磷酰胺、依托泊苷），再做局部治疗，局部治疗的时机由多学科团队决定，之后巩固治疗，总疗程10–12个月；女性患者在有条件时应考虑生育力咨询（她尚未进入青春期，可考虑卵巢组织冻存）。化疗在融合基因结果和分期检查回报之后开始。
feedback.en: Right. ESMO 2021: bone sarcoma is treated at reference centres; for Ewing sarcoma, induction chemotherapy (vincristine, doxorubicin, cyclophosphamide or ifosfamide, etoposide) comes first, then local therapy at a time the multidisciplinary team decides, then consolidation, 10–12 months in all; for girls a fertility consultation should be considered where available (she is prepubertal, so ovarian tissue cryopreservation). Chemotherapy starts once the fusion result and the staging tests are back.

text.zh-CN: 趁肿瘤还能切、化疗还没把她身体拖垮，先把右髂骨整块切掉；只有术后病理提示切缘阳性，或三个月后复查PET-CT发现其他骨病灶增大时才化疗。
text.en: Resect the right ilium first, in one piece, while the tumour is still operable and before chemotherapy can weaken her, and give chemotherapy only if the pathologist reports involved margins or the other bone lesions grow on a repeat PET-CT in three months' time.

feedback.zh-CN: 尤文肉瘤按全身性疾病治疗：ESMO 2021先做诱导化疗，再在多学科团队决定的时机做局部治疗；先手术会让微小转移得不到治疗。国家卫健委2019年规范也指出单纯局部治疗的复发率高达80%–90%。
feedback.en: Ewing sarcoma is treated as a systemic disease: ESMO 2021 gives induction chemotherapy first and local therapy afterwards, at a time the multidisciplinary team decides; operating first leaves micrometastatic disease untreated, and China's 2019 national guideline notes relapse rates of 80–90 % with local treatment alone.

text.zh-CN: 对骨盆和每一处PET高摄取的骨做根治性放疗，作为唯一的治疗；她才三岁，多药化疗毒性太大，不值得冒险，放疗还能免去骨盆大手术。
text.en: Give radical radiotherapy to the pelvis and to every PET-avid bone as her only treatment, because at three years of age multi-agent chemotherapy is too toxic to be worth the risk, and radiotherapy spares her a major pelvic operation.

feedback.zh-CN: 放疗是局部治疗的一种选择，不能代替化疗：ESMO 2021指出，在没有全身治疗的年代，历史队列的5年生存率不到10%。她年龄小，需要儿童肿瘤团队和细致的支持治疗，而不是省去化疗。
feedback.en: Radiotherapy is one option for local control, not a substitute for chemotherapy: ESMO 2021 notes that without systemic treatment 5-year survival was under 10 % in historical series. Her young age calls for a paediatric oncology team and careful supportive care, not for leaving chemotherapy out.

text.zh-CN: 诊断时多处骨病灶无法治愈，只提供舒适照护，由姑息治疗团队在家照顾，让她免受化疗、手术和放疗的副作用。
text.en: Offer comfort care only, at home with the palliative care team, because bone lesions in several places at diagnosis cannot be cured, and spare her the side effects of chemotherapy, surgery and radiotherapy.

feedback.zh-CN: 多发骨病灶的预后确实更差，但ESMO 2021对转移性尤文肉瘤仍采用同样的多学科综合治疗。姑息治疗团队可以与抗肿瘤治疗同时支持这个家庭，而不是在诊断时取代治疗。
feedback.en: Multiple bone lesions do carry a poorer outlook, but ESMO 2021 treats metastatic Ewing sarcoma with the same multimodal approach. Palliative care can support the family alongside treatment; it does not replace treatment at diagnosis.

text.zh-CN: 问清发热、跛行、激素治疗及其反应和抗感染治疗，并追问起病时皮肤黏膜表现、夜间疼痛、体重和盗汗以及激素剂量
text.en: Took the history of the fever, the limp, the steroid course and response and the anti-infective treatment, and asked about the skin and mouth at onset, night pain, weight and sweats and the steroid dose

text.zh-CN: 检查面色、浅表淋巴结、皮肤、踝和足背、髋部（“4”字试验）以及肌力和肌张力
text.en: Examined her colour, lymph nodes, skin, ankles and feet, hips (figure-four test) and muscle power and tone

text.zh-CN: 没有直接接受全身型JIA的诊断，先检查而不加强治疗（第一次即答对）
text.en: Did not take the systemic JIA label at face value and investigated before escalating (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 送检能区分白血病、神经母细胞瘤、感染和巨噬细胞活化综合征的检查：血涂片、血培养、尿儿茶酚胺代谢物，以及铁蛋白、甘油三酯和肝酶
text.en: Sent the tests that separate leukaemia, neuroblastoma, infection and macrophage activation: blood film, blood culture, urine catecholamine metabolites, and ferritin, triglycerides and liver enzymes

text.zh-CN: 调阅血常规、血沉和C反应蛋白、乳酸脱氢酶、自身抗体和病毒学检查、骨髓以及每一项影像记录
text.en: Read the blood count, ESR and CRP, LDH, autoantibody and viral tests, the marrow and every imaging record

text.zh-CN: 把未见明显破坏的平片、阴性的骨髓与MRI和CT放在一起解读，判断需要组织（第一次即答对）
text.en: Read films without obvious destruction and a negative marrow against the MRI and CT and concluded that tissue was needed (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 选对由谁、在哪里、怎样取组织（第一次即答对）
text.en: Chose who should take the tissue, where and how (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 在任何取材之前转诊儿童肿瘤及骨肉瘤团队
text.en: Referred her to the paediatric oncology and bone sarcoma team before any tissue was taken

text.zh-CN: 活检按骨肉瘤团队的规划进行，且在调阅血常规、送检凝血之后
text.en: Had the biopsy done as the bone sarcoma team planned it, after the blood count was read and clotting was sent

text.zh-CN: 没有为“关节炎”标签做激素冲击，也没有擅自切开切除髂骨包块
text.en: Gave no steroid pulse for the arthritis label and had no unplanned excision of the iliac mass

text.zh-CN: 没有为“关节炎”标签开始生物制剂，没有在留培养和组织之前再给抗生素，也没有在看血常规之前输血
text.en: Started no biologic for the arthritis label, gave no antibiotics before cultures and tissue were taken, and transfused nothing before reading her blood count

text.zh-CN: 判断活检和PET-CT能确定什么（第一次即答对），并送检融合基因和胸部CT
text.en: Judged what the biopsy and PET-CT establish (first attempt), and sent fusion testing and a chest CT

text.zh-CN: 选定治疗路径（第一次即答对），有了组织诊断才转科化疗，并安排生育力保存讨论和家属谈话
text.en: Chose the treatment pathway (first attempt), transferred her for chemotherapy only after the tissue diagnosis, and arranged the fertility discussion and the family meeting

text.zh-CN: 向家长说明为什么要重新考虑诊断、检查的目的，以及活检结果和仍不确定之处，并核实理解
text.en: Explained to her parent why the diagnosis was being reconsidered, what the tests were for, the biopsy result and what is still uncertain, and checked understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（Calgary–Cambridge；告知诊断时用SPIKES）：入院时向清和和家长自我介绍，用通俗的话问病史；说明为什么要重新考虑“关节炎”的诊断，不指责外院；解释为什么暂不加量激素、每项检查查什么，并用回授法确认家长听懂了计划。活检结果出来后：选安静的房间，请儿童肿瘤科医生和护士在场；先问家长已经了解什么、想知道多少；先给出预警，再用通俗的话说明活检显示的是一种叫尤文肉瘤的骨肿瘤，其他骨病灶可能是转移，也可能是多处原发，尚未证实；说明还不确定的部分（确认用的基因检测、胸部检查）和接下来要做什么（在儿童肿瘤团队治疗、先化疗、治疗前讨论生育力保存）；回应情绪，留出提问时间，用回授法确认理解，约定下次谈话。不引用本例无法支持的生存率数字，也不把原报告没有记录的治疗说成已经做过。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge; SPIKES for the diagnosis): on admission, introduces themself to Qinghe and her parent and takes the history in plain words; explains why the arthritis diagnosis is being reconsidered without blaming the other hospital; explains why the steroids are not being increased and what each test is for, and checks by teach-back that the parent has understood the plan. When the biopsy is back: a quiet room with the paediatric oncologist and the nurse; asks what the parent already knows and wants to know; gives a warning shot, then says in plain words that the biopsy shows a bone tumour called Ewing sarcoma and that the other bone lesions may be spread from it or several primary sites, not yet proven; explains what is still uncertain (the confirming gene test, the chest scan) and what happens next (treatment with a children's cancer team, chemotherapy first, a fertility discussion before treatment); responds to emotion, leaves time for questions, checks understanding by teach-back and agrees when to talk again. Quotes no survival figure the case cannot support and describes no treatment the report does not record as given.

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科上级医师，用苏格拉底式提问带教、按PEARLS复盘，只围绕学员已经得到的资料提问，例如：“全身型JIA这个诊断的依据是什么？她真正具备其中哪些表现？”“发热、跛行的孩子出现哪些表现时，你会在加用激素之前停下来？”“未见明显破坏的骨盆平片和阴性的骨髓检查能排除什么、不能排除什么？”“骨盆包块该由谁来取组织？取之前要先查什么？”“没有融合基因结果的活检报告，按今天的标准能确定什么？”提醒学员在任何麻醉前先问清她的激素剂量和疗程，激素不能突然停。说明这份报告发表于2012年，没有融合基因结果；而2020年WHO分类以FET–ETS融合来界定尤文肉瘤，并把形态相似的圆细胞肉瘤单列。不提前透露诊断、决策答案或结局。她的生命体征、白细胞计数、铁蛋白、血涂片、凝血、培养、尿儿茶酚胺、胸部影像、激素种类和剂量、用过的抗生素、活检方式、融合基因状态和化疗方案都没有记录，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: Paediatric attending who teaches by Socratic questions and debriefs with PEARLS, asking only about what the learner already has, e.g. “What does the systemic JIA label rest on, and which of its features does she actually have?”, “Which findings in a child with fever and a limp make you stop before giving more steroids?”, “What can pelvic films without obvious destruction and a negative marrow exclude — and what not?”, “Who should take tissue from a pelvic mass, and what must be checked first?”, “By today's standard, what does a biopsy report without a fusion result establish?”. Reminds the learner to find out her steroid dose and duration before any anaesthetic, and that steroids are not stopped abruptly. Explains that the report was published in 2012 and gives no fusion result, whereas the 2020 WHO classification defines Ewing sarcoma by its FET–ETS fusion and sets look-alike round-cell sarcomas apart. Never reveals the diagnosis, a decision's answer or the outcome early. Her vital signs, white cell count, ferritin, blood film, clotting, cultures, urine catecholamines, chest imaging, the steroid and its dose, the antibiotics used, the biopsy approach, the fusion status and the chemotherapy regimen are not recorded, and the attending does not supply them.

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科病房护士。交班（ISBAR）：S——清和，3岁9个月，体重15.9 kg，因发热70余天、逐渐跛行入院；面色苍白，躺在床上，家长陪着。B——此前被诊断为全身型幼年特发性关节炎，外院按此给她用了激素，热退后在继续口服期间又发热；近一个月断断续续抗感染，发热仍加重。A——交给我的病历里没有她在病房的生命体征。R——请今天来看她。可以抽血查血常规和涂片、血培养、凝血、铁蛋白和配血，留尿，和血库联系输血，预约影像检查，联系肿瘤科。复述医嘱，只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到没有记录的内容（激素名称和剂量、过敏）时直接说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Children's ward nurse. Handover (ISBAR): S — Qinghe, 3 years 9 months, 15.9 kg, admitted with fever for more than 70 days and a limp that came on gradually; she is pale, lying in bed, and her parent is with her. B — previously diagnosed with systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis, for which another hospital gave steroids; the fever settled and came back while she was still taking them by mouth; on-and-off treatment for infection for about a month has not stopped the fever getting worse. A — the notes handed over to me have no ward observations for her. R — please review her today. Can take blood for a count and film, cultures, clotting, ferritin and group and screen, collect urine, set up a transfusion with the blood bank, book imaging and call the oncology team. Reads orders back, reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and says plainly when something is not recorded (the steroid's name and dose, allergies).

name.zh-CN: 唐医生（儿童肿瘤科会诊）

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿童肿瘤科会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的结果，不补充病例没有记录的结果。可以讲解ESMO–EURACAN–GENTURIS–ERN PaedCan 2021：5岁以下儿童的破坏性骨病灶最常见的是转移性神经母细胞瘤或朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞增生症；平片不能排除恶性时做包括整个间室的MRI；影像怀疑原发骨肉瘤时转诊到具备儿童专长的专科中心；活检由将做根治手术的外科团队进行，或由介入放射科医生与该外科医生商定后进行，通常为影像引导下粗针活检，穿刺道要标记并在日后切除；尤文肉瘤必须做分子确认（FET–ETS融合，通常为EWSR1–FLI1）；分期用胸部CT和PET-CT或全身MRI，可疑病灶要活检，做了PET-CT时骨髓活检和穿刺不作强制要求；诱导化疗、由多学科团队决定时机的局部治疗、巩固治疗，总疗程10–12个月；女性患者有条件时考虑生育力咨询。还可以讲WHO 2020分类：CIC重排肉瘤和BCOR改变肉瘤与尤文肉瘤分开。不提前给出决策答案或结局。
knowledge.en: Paediatric oncology consultant who interprets only results the learner has already read and adds no result the case does not record. Can explain ESMO–EURACAN–GENTURIS–ERN PaedCan 2021: under 5 years a destructive bone lesion is most often metastatic neuroblastoma or Langerhans cell histiocytosis; MRI of the whole compartment when radiographs cannot exclude malignancy; referral of a suspected primary bone sarcoma to a reference centre with paediatric expertise; biopsy by the surgical team who will do the resection, or by an interventional radiologist after discussing it with that surgeon, usually an image-guided core biopsy, with the tract marked and later excised; molecular confirmation of Ewing sarcoma mandatory (a FET–ETS fusion, usually EWSR1–FLI1); staging with chest CT and PET-CT or whole-body MRI, doubtful lesions biopsied, marrow biopsy and aspirate not mandated when PET-CT is done; induction chemotherapy, local therapy timed by the multidisciplinary team, then consolidation, 10–12 months in all; a fertility consultation for girls where available. And the WHO 2020 classification, which separates CIC-rearranged and BCOR-altered sarcomas from Ewing sarcoma. Never gives a decision's answer or the outcome early.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：长期发热、跛行与“关节炎”标签
title.en: Debrief: prolonged fever, a limp and an arthritis label

conclusion.zh-CN: 清和3岁9个月，发热七十多天——起初38℃左右，后来最高39.5℃、一天数次——逐渐出现轻度跛行，面色苍白。此前她被诊断为全身型幼年特发性关节炎，在外院用激素后热退，继续口服期间又发热；近一个月断断续续抗感染，发热仍加重。这个诊断并不吻合：起病时无皮疹，查体无浅表淋巴结肿大，血小板最低65×10⁹/L，血红蛋白55–80 g/L，乳酸脱氢酶1312 U/L。平片未见明显骨质破坏，但MRI示右髂骨及周围包块伴弥散受限，增强CT示包绕髂骨的肿块、骨膜反应和骶骨异常；骨髓检查为红系增生，未报告确诊的肿瘤浸润。右髂骨活检报告为尤文瘤，未给出融合基因结果；PET-CT示多部位骨病灶，考虑转移或多中心。确诊后她转血液科化疗，疗效和结局没有报告。今天的做法是：排除肿瘤和感染之前不加强免疫抑制，巨噬细胞活化综合征要检查证实而不是假定；任何取材之前先转诊儿童骨肉瘤专科团队；用融合基因检测确认诊断；完成分期；按现行方案治疗，治疗前先讨论生育力保存。
conclusion.en: Qinghe, aged 3 years 9 months, had fever for more than 70 days — about 38 °C at first, later up to 39.5 °C several times a day — a mild limp that came on gradually, and pallor. She had been diagnosed with systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis and given steroids at another hospital; the fever settled and came back while she was still taking them by mouth, and on-and-off anti-infective treatment for about a month did not stop it worsening. The label did not fit: there was no rash at onset, no enlarged lymph nodes, platelets as low as 65 × 10⁹/L, haemoglobin 55–80 g/L and an LDH of 1312 U/L. Radiographs showed no obvious destruction, but MRI showed a mass in and around the right ilium with restricted diffusion, and contrast-enhanced CT a mass encasing the ilium with periosteal reaction and a sacral abnormality; the marrow showed erythroid hyperplasia without confirmed tumour. A right iliac biopsy was reported as Ewing tumour, without a fusion result, and PET-CT showed multiple bone lesions considered metastatic or multicentric. She was transferred to the haematology department for chemotherapy; her response and outcome are not reported. Today: hold further immunosuppression until malignancy and infection are excluded, and test for macrophage activation rather than assume it; refer to a paediatric bone sarcoma team before any tissue is taken; confirm the diagnosis with fusion testing; complete staging; and treat on a current protocol, with fertility preservation discussed first.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 诊断标签要有自己的依据：全身型JIA需要关节炎、发热至少2周，并至少有皮疹、全身淋巴结肿大、肝脾肿大或浆膜炎之一（ILAR）；她起病时无皮疹、无淋巴结肿大，而激素能退热并不能说明发热的原因。
keyReasoning.en: A label needs its own criteria: systemic JIA needs arthritis, fever for at least 2 weeks and at least one of rash, generalised lymphadenopathy, hepatosplenomegaly or serositis (ILAR); she had no rash at onset and no enlarged nodes, and a fever that settles on steroids says nothing about its cause.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 跛行的孩子血小板低、乳酸脱氢酶1312 U/L、血沉和C反应蛋白升高，指向肿瘤或感染而不是关节炎：先检查再治疗，巨噬细胞活化综合征也要有证据才按它处理。
keyReasoning.en: Low platelets, an LDH of 1312 U/L and a raised ESR and CRP in a limping child point to malignancy or infection rather than arthritis: test before treating, and treat macrophage activation only once it is shown.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 骨盆平片未见明显破坏、骨髓阴性，都排除不了骨盆肿瘤；MRI和CT显示髂骨包块伴骨膜反应，所以需要组织。
keyReasoning.en: Pelvic films without obvious destruction and a negative marrow do not exclude a pelvic tumour; MRI and CT showed an iliac mass with periosteal reaction, so tissue is needed.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 可疑骨肉瘤的组织应由将来做切除的团队来取，或与他们商定后取；穿刺道要能切除，取材前要知道血小板和凝血。
keyReasoning.en: Tissue from a suspected bone sarcoma is taken by, or with, the team who will resect it, along a tract that can be removed, once the platelet count and clotting are known.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: “尤文瘤、无融合基因结果”的活检和未逐个取材的PET病灶，是需要补全的工作诊断：做融合基因检测、胸部CT，对会改变方案的病灶活检，然后按方案化疗，由团队决定局部治疗的时机。
keyReasoning.en: A biopsy reported as Ewing tumour without a fusion result, and PET lesions that were not each sampled, are a working diagnosis to complete — fusion testing, a chest CT and a biopsy of any lesion that would change the plan — before protocol chemotherapy with local control timed by the team.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单个已发表病例不能说明这种情况有多常见，也不能说明哪种治疗效果更好；原报告的经过作为历史回看，教学答案依据现行指南。
boundaries.en: A single published report cannot show how often this happens or how well any treatment works; the report's course is reviewed as history, and the teaching answers follow current guidance.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 全身型JIA（Still病）只有在排除其他疾病后才能诊断。EULAR/PReS 2024（推荐3）要求认真考虑肿瘤、感染以及其他炎症性和自身炎症性疾病，并提醒误诊时糖皮质激素或免疫调节药可能有害，尤其是肿瘤；ACR 2021对无巨噬细胞活化综合征的全身型JIA，有条件地不推荐以口服激素作为初始单药治疗。原报告中，她在骨病灶活检之前就因“关节炎”标签用上了激素。
teachingPoints.en: Systemic JIA (Still's disease) is diagnosed only once its mimics are excluded. EULAR/PReS 2024 (recommendation 3) asks that malignancy, infection and other inflammatory and autoinflammatory diseases be carefully considered, and warns that glucocorticoids or immunomodulators can be deleterious when the disease is misdiagnosed, particularly in malignancy; ACR 2021 conditionally recommends against oral glucocorticoids as initial monotherapy for systemic JIA without macrophage activation. In the report, she was given steroids for the arthritis label before the bone lesion was biopsied.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 发热、跛行儿童的肿瘤警示：NICE NG12（2015，2026年更新）对面色苍白、不明原因发热或持续/不明原因骨痛的儿童要求尽快查血常规（推荐1.10.3），对不明原因骨肿胀或骨痛建议考虑尽快拍X线片（1.11.3）。被贴上“关节炎”标签的孩子出现血小板减少，应在排除白血病、神经母细胞瘤和骨肿瘤之前停止加强免疫抑制。
teachingPoints.en: Malignancy red flags in a child with fever and a limp: NICE NG12 (2015, updated 2026) asks for a very urgent blood count in children with pallor, unexplained fever or persistent or unexplained bone pain (recommendation 1.10.3), and suggests considering a very urgent X-ray for unexplained bone swelling or pain (1.11.3). Thrombocytopenia in a child labelled with arthritis should stop any escalation of immunosuppression until leukaemia, neuroblastoma and bone tumours are excluded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 平片是第一步，不是最后一步。ESMO–EURACAN–GENTURIS–ERN PaedCan 2021要求平片不能排除恶性时做包括整个间室的MRI，认为MRI是骨盆肿瘤局部分期的最佳方法，并指出5岁以下儿童的破坏性骨病灶最常见的是转移性神经母细胞瘤或朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞增生症——3岁患尤文肉瘤并不常见，要靠活检来定。
teachingPoints.en: Radiographs are the first test, not the last. ESMO–EURACAN–GENTURIS–ERN PaedCan 2021 asks for MRI of the whole compartment when radiographs cannot exclude malignancy, regards MRI as the best local staging for pelvic tumours, and notes that under 5 years of age a destructive bone lesion is most often metastatic neuroblastoma or Langerhans cell histiocytosis — Ewing sarcoma at 3 years is uncommon, so the biopsy decides.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 可疑骨肉瘤的活检（ESMO 2021）：转诊到具备儿童专长的专科中心；由将做根治手术的外科团队活检，或由介入放射科医生与该外科医生商定后进行，通常为影像引导下粗针活检；穿刺道要标记，日后随肿瘤一并切除；尤文肉瘤应避免病灶内手术。ESPID 2017提醒用抗生素前一定先做血培养，并指出亚急性骨髓炎可与恶性肿瘤混淆、通常需要活检——所以活检组织也要送培养。
teachingPoints.en: Biopsy of a suspected bone sarcoma (ESMO 2021): refer to a reference centre with paediatric expertise; the biopsy is done by the surgical team who will resect the tumour, or by an interventional radiologist after discussing it with that surgeon, usually as an image-guided core biopsy; the tract is marked and later removed with the tumour; intralesional surgery is to be avoided in Ewing sarcoma. ESPID 2017 asks for a blood culture before any antibiotic and notes that subacute osteomyelitis can be confused with malignancy and usually needs a biopsy — so the biopsy also goes for culture.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 过去与现在：这份2012年发表的报告仅凭病理诊断为“尤文瘤”，没有融合基因结果。ESMO 2021规定必须做分子确认（FET–ETS融合，通常为EWSR1–FLI1），WHO 2020分类把行为不同的CIC重排肉瘤和BCOR改变肉瘤单列；我国《儿童及青少年尤文肉瘤诊疗规范（2019年版）》也指出一般推荐用FISH检测EWSR1易位，因FISH可能假阴性，实验室条件允许时尽量用PCR验证。
teachingPoints.en: Then and now: the report, published in 2012, diagnosed 'Ewing tumour' on histology without a fusion result. ESMO 2021 makes molecular confirmation mandatory (a FET–ETS fusion, usually EWSR1–FLI1), and the WHO 2020 classification places CIC-rearranged and BCOR-altered sarcomas, which behave differently, apart; China's 2019 national guideline for Ewing sarcoma in children and adolescents notes that FISH is the usual test for the EWSR1 rearrangement and, because FISH can miss it, asks for PCR confirmation where the laboratory allows.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 分期与治疗（ESMO 2021）：胸部CT和PET-CT（或全身MRI），可疑病灶要活检（做了PET-CT时不强制要求骨髓活检）；先诱导化疗，再由多学科团队决定时机做局部治疗，之后巩固，总疗程10–12个月；多发骨转移的预后明显差于肺转移；女性患者治疗前在有条件时考虑生育力咨询（青春期前为卵巢组织冻存）。
teachingPoints.en: Staging and treatment (ESMO 2021): chest CT and PET-CT (or whole-body MRI), with biopsy of doubtful lesions (marrow biopsy is not mandated when PET-CT is done); induction chemotherapy, then local therapy timed by the multidisciplinary team, then consolidation, 10–12 months in all; multiple bone metastases carry a much poorer outcome than lung metastases; for girls, consider a fertility consultation before treatment where available (ovarian tissue cryopreservation before puberty).
